description: A component wires its `onSave` prop as a RAW handler reference (`onclick=onSave`). The call site `<Btn onSave=risky/>` passes a `!` function, so that instance's `onclick` is a failable handler reference: E-ERROR-002, exactly once, reported at the call-site prop. The call site `<Btn onSave=plain/>` passes a non-failable function and is clean.
rationale: §19.4.3 (S441) — a failable function passed as a handler reference SHALL be E-ERROR-002 in every position a handler is checked in, including a component body; the call site is where the failable function is chosen.
